name: CalorieTracker
description: REST API for nutrition tracking and body-weight management. ASP.NET Core 9, Clean Architecture, JWT auth, dependency-free nutrition calculations, EF Core + SQL Server, deployed to Azure.

paragraphs: A REST backend for nutrition tracking and body-weight management, built with ASP.NET Core 9 on a clean, layered architecture. It derives a user's daily energy and macronutrient targets from their profile and tracks meals, water, weight, products, and recipes against those targets with all dietary math implemented as dependency-free domain logic.
Live API & Swagger UI · API Reference (DocFX)
CalorieTracker turns a user profile into a personalized nutrition plan and then tracks progress against it:
features: Register and confirm the account with a one-time email code.
Complete the profile - age, gender, height, weight, target weight, activity level, goal, weekly pace, and a meal plan.
From that profile the API computes daily calorie, macronutrient, and water targets.
Log meals, water, and weight; query daily progress, history, and trends.
Browse a shared product catalog, add custom products, and compose recipes whose nutrition is calculated from their ingredients.
